pages.text: A $(item)Rift Knot$() ties a spawner to the rift. What it spawns folds into one creature, up to 64 deep.

pages.title: One for Many
pages.text: A folded creature has the health of one and the loot of all. In my pit it suffers for all of them. In my well it leaves a ghost for each.$(br2)I press the knot to the ground where they should gather, within 32 of the spawner, and then to the spawner itself.
